boundaries: In fixture profiles, the model is an independent protocol fixture selected through a private control file. It performs no keyword routing and does not establish live model semantic accuracy or calibration.
The actual C API, generated Coax admission/output policies, PostgreSQL quota transaction and NIP-98 verifier execute normally; there is no API route or database mock.
The harness verifies current_database() against ANIME_ISOLATED_DB before touching anime.calls. Only the dedicated fixture database is reset; no other agent's fixture or production data is touched.
Fresh signing secrets exist only in memory and the owned concurrency child's environment. No owner key, credential, signature header or session cookie is retained in the receipts.
Retained samples contain only synthetic director words, typed stage data, generated answers and a quota ledger projection with identity omitted.
The harness owns and stops its selector process group and removes its temporary control directory. The API/database remain under the parent agent's lifecycle.

The fixture and development-Origin profiles use only an owned loopback selector: no external provider call, staging/production write, deployment, visible browser, sound or payment. Separate real-provider profiles are named explicitly; provider-controls.json records the parent agent's synthetic development controls, not these fixture runs.

This record does not claim complete renderer, CLI, live voice, published realm or production readiness. Later source profiles must retain separate identities; unchanged passing gates are not rerun merely to confirm them.
